visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and glasses, wearing a light blue button-down shirt with a name tag, stands in a brightly lit television studio. He holds a small, light-brown plush sofa shaped like a bear, rotating it to show its details to the camera. The background features colorful arched doorways and shelving units filled with framed artwork. (2) The camera zooms in on a display table covered in pink and purple surfaces. Various bear-themed merchandise items are visible, including fuzzy bear-ear headbands, plush slippers with bows, and small bear keychains. A yellow sign with the text 'Butter Bear' is visible on the table. (3) The man stands beside a large poster board titled '爆紅 奶油小熊' featuring photos of a mascot character. He gestures enthusiastically with both hands while speaking. The setting includes a world map on an easel and bright studio lighting that casts even shadows. (4) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige blazer and black shorts, enters the frame. The man hands her a small bear-shaped item, and they both smile and laugh. The man continues to gesture excitedly while the woman holds the item close to her face, looking at it with interest.
